# Skill: platform port

Order: web → **Windows** → **Android** → macOS + iOS (rule `finch-platforms`).

## Desktop (Tauri 2 — Windows first, then macOS)

1. Reuse `packages/ui-web` screens; the desktop shell adds window chrome, menus, keyboard shortcuts,
   native notifications, file import (drag & drop) and offline cache (cache only, never truth).
2. Tauri capabilities: grant the minimum (no shell, scoped fs/dialog only when a feature needs it);
   CSP on.
3. Build and smoke-test on the target OS runner in CI; sign installers when certificates exist.

## Mobile (Expo — Android first, then iOS)

1. Rebuild the screen with `packages/ui-mobile` (same tokens, native primitives); do not embed web
   views for core flows.
2. Mobile conventions: bottom tabs matching the 5 destinations, safe areas, back gesture, haptics
   on confirmations, camera for receipts, biometric gate for sensitive views.
3. SecureStore for small tokens only; minimal cache; push payloads without sensitive data.
4. Test on emulator + one physical device; Expo build for distribution.

## Done when

Feature parity checklist ticked (data, states, receipts, i18n, a11y) and platform-specific
checklist ticked; screenshots per platform in the PR.
